campaign: P06 L02-U1 unified local acceptance R01; authenticated UI route addendum
scope: Incremental authentication/UI-gate follow-up only; P02, Office #71 and full Provider/U1 campaign were not rerun.

environment.freshIsolatedProfile: r12; config, userData, HOME, XDG, Pi, sessions and workspace all isolated under private evidence root
environment.applicationPorts: loopback; Vite 5174 plus fresh renderer/Main inspector ports

steps.actual: Electron 43.7.7 client launched; remote debugging bound to loopback

steps.command: CDP click onboarding controls; final Continue selector first attempted, then corrected to the visible skip control
steps.expected: reach ordinary app shell without importing user configuration
steps.actual: onboarding tour skipped; no migration/import action

steps.command: node <PRIVATE_EVIDENCE>/setup/submit-login-r12.mjs; login values supplied via no-echo stdin and not in argv/env/files
steps.expected: real UI submit reaches Main auth IPC with rememberPassword=false
steps.actual: Main getAccount IPC reported active; login form disappeared; persistence metadata confirmed rememberPassword=false and encryptedPassword empty

steps.command: CDP mouse click on Material Review card; call window.reviewAPI.listCases and listCasesV2 through preload/Main IPC
steps.expected: real review UI route mounts without opening any case
steps.actual: review region and toolbar mounted; local V1/V2 case counts 0; no case, demo case, run, assignment, turn or SourceRef created

steps.command: window.electronAPI.cdutZone.logout; query getAccount; terminate isolated process groups; remove r12 profile/session/workspace
steps.expected: remove active auth and local profile state
steps.actual: logout resolved, account status disconnected, account file removed, profile and workspace destroyed

identifiers.reason: no review case or run was opened or created

limits: Login succeeded through real CDUT auth Main IPC, but this does not constitute a Provider-generated review receipt or full U1 business replay.

The CDUT auth implementation automatically fetches account profile fields on successful login; they were not inspected or included in evidence, and logout plus profile destruction removed local account artifacts.

Interactive command outputs were not captured by the command runner. The retained private receipt is a sanitized structured summary, not a raw log. Electron Main stdout was discarded to avoid persisting profile fields.
One onboarding selector attempt failed because the final slide button label differs; the failure is retained in defects-and-first-failures.json and corrected via the visible skip control.
